name: Graph Property Equivalence Obfuscation
description: Replaced the non-2-colorable contradiction with a mathematically equivalent but conceptually distant property: a 3-node graph being resilient to any single edge removal (2-edge-connected). This forces models to logically deduce that a minimum degree of 2 in a 3-node graph implies a triangle (K3 clique), defeating models that rely on surface pattern-matching of 2-coloring contradictions.
